Segnala offerta di lavoro At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. After an intensive training period of six to twelve months, you’ll take on a leadership role—either as the sole leader or co-leader—of a business unit generating revenue in the tens of millions of dollars at a minimum. You’ll have the autonomy to make decisions and lead execution. As you demonstrate what you can do, your remit can expand into new areas or other businesses across our portfolio, potentially reaching hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue. This leadership position is open to individuals with an outstanding track record of performance and growth, even without a decade of experience. We’re looking for candidates who have previously led high-performing teams, and have backgrounds in entrepreneurial ventures, investment banking, or technology. Excellent references from highly reputable professionals will be essential. A few examples of your responsibilities Shape the strategy. Own the direction of a product or major product area. Decide which problems matter most, which opportunities to pursue, and which to pass on, then turn those choices into a roadmap. For example, you might decide whether a team’s next six months are best spent improving retention, reaching a new customer segment, or launching a new feature. Analyze and test. Use data, AI, user research, and market analysis to test hypotheses across the user journey. For example, you might identify where users who churn in their first month run into problems, test ways to improve their experience, and use the findings to improve retention. Grow the business. Find the best ways to attract new users and increase revenue. That can mean expanding the marketing channels that work best, building partnerships, or making the product easier to find in search results and AI assistants. Turn ideas into features. Spot opportunities by analyzing user feedback and customer support requests, and by comparing your product with the best on the market. Then work with designers and engineers to build and launch the solution. Lead complex projects. Take charge of projects involving people in different roles across different teams. Figure out how the business works and build a plan to move it forward. For example, you might redesign a process that’s holding back growth or lead a major improvement to a product used by millions. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education. Commitment & contract Permanent. Full-time. Location Milan (Italy), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland). The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you. About Us Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives. By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need. What You’ll Be Doing As our Growth Tech Lead, you’ll be the person who turns technology, AI and data into Satispay’s next growth engine. You’ll lead a team of growth engineers and growth managers, own the roadmap of what we build, and scale the channels and products that will drive the next chapter of our growth. Referral loops, promotion systems, web apps and AI tools for growth: you’ll own them the way a product owner owns a product. That means defining the problem, prioritising the backlog, running structured experiments and shipping to scale, from first prototype to winning feature. Here’s What Your Day-to-day Will Look Like Incubate the next growth features - Turn raw ideas into experiments and minimum viable products (MVPs) that can become new growth features for Satispay or, just as valuable, a clear learning. Be our tech and AI voice in Marketing & Growth - Be the go-to person for how technology and AI can change the way we acquire, activate and retain users. Lead and grow your team - Manage and develop a team of 4 (for now!) made up of AI engineers and growth managers, setting a high bar and creating the space for them to own real problems. Own the roadmap and the sprints - Define priorities, run planning and delivery for the team, and make sure what we ship moves real business metrics. Own and scale referral loops - Take ownership of member-get-member, our referral programme and biggest marketing channel, and design, test and scale referral mechanics for each new Satispay product. Build and ship data products - Take projects from quick AI-built prototype to production, from web apps to growth products that can become part of the Satispay product suite, working closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations and Data. Grow Satispay organically - Own our website and landing pages with one goal: organically growing the Satispay user base. That means search strategy, content and technical performance, and a constant cycle of experimentation and conversion optimisation. Who We’re Looking For We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you’re curious and ready for real ownership, you’ll fit in! Does this sound like you? Proven experience - 6+ years of experience in marketing/growth, tech product management and/or software engineering. Technical credibility - You’ve shipped production-grade products and can hold a real conversation with engineers about architecture, trade-offs and quality. Applied AI & automation mindset - You follow what’s happening in AI and know how to turn it into business-ready solutions that solve concrete problems. Growth & referral expertise - You understand funnels, experimentation and conversion optimisation, and ideally you’ve built or scaled referral or viral loops. Product mindset & Project Management - You’re comfortable owning a roadmap, prioritising ruthlessly, and taking ideas from 0→1. Cross-functional influence - You build trust and alignment with Product, Marketing, Sales and Data, even without formal authority. Impact-driven attitude - You’re driven by projects that move real metrics and you’re at ease navigating ambiguity. CareAbout: how we support your impact About We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health (Private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops) 💰 Financial resources (Stock Option Plan, Meal vouchers, Relocation support if you’re moving countries) ⚙️ Growth and development (Professional development programs, Internal mobility, Language courses with Preply) 🌱 Flexibility (Unlimited PTO, Hybrid working policy*, Flexible working hours) 👨‍👩‍👧 Family (Enhanced parental leave, Additional leave for child sickness) We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time. Salary: €55.000 - €75.000 gross per annumThis range is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role’s core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value. Equal opportunity employer At Satispay, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs! Learn More About Us Our values and pillars aren’t just fancy words on a page - they really shape everything we do. Explore them here. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro About Us Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of. What You'll Be Doing As our Country Manager - Merchant, you’ll play a key role in driving sales and profitable growth across Satispay’s core merchant business. You will hold the strategic and operational responsibility, including the P&L (profit and loss), for our core merchant ecosystem, the most iconic and foundational business we have. Your mission is to maximize sales, find new ways to monetize, lead our commercial teams, and be the strongest advocate for merchants’ needs and market trends. This is a permanent role based in Milan, with a flexible hybrid working policy. This is an opportunity to lead within a high-growth, constantly evolving environment – a challenge perfectly suited for an executive ready to navigate and shape change at scale and contribute to something bigger. Here's What Your Day-to-day Will Look Like Own the Merchant P&L and strategy - Define, drive, and execute the commercial strategy for the Merchant business, delivering sustainable revenue growth and profitability. Lead and scale the sales teams - Directly manage and mentor the sales organization. Sharpen commercial processes, targets, and performance to maximize market penetration. Be the voice of the merchant - Dig into merchants’ needs, pain points, and industry trends, and turn them into clear, actionable feedback for our product and growth strategies. Spot monetization opportunities - Keep analyzing the merchant landscape to identify, test, and launch new feature-driven or service-driven ways to monetize. Thrive in a matrix structure - Work closely with cross-functional teams, such as Product and Growth, among others, to align the product roadmap with merchant expectations and make execution seamless. You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership. Who We're Looking For This role needs a proven leader with a distinguished track record of success in driving strategic initiatives and achieving significant business growth within relevant sectors. You will lead by example, combining ambition with purpose, drive impactful results, and cultivate ownership and continuous improvement in our dynamic environment. Business acumen and P&L ownership - 5-8+ years in senior leadership roles (General Manager, Head of Business or VP of Sales) with full accountability for a business line’s P&L, ideally scaling merchant-facing or business-to-business-to-consumer (B2B2C) business lines. Sales leadership - Proven experience directly managing, structuring, and motivating high-performing sales teams, preferably in Fintech, Payments, Retail Tech, or Marketplace, backed by a strong commercial drive. Experience and expertise in acquiring, payment acceptance, and point-of-sale (POS) solutions is a plus. Monetization and growth mindset - A sharp eye for untapped revenue streams, upselling opportunities, and strategic partnerships within a merchant ecosystem. Matrix organization expertise - Strong ability to navigate and influence in a matrix environment, bridging the gap between field sales and central product and growth teams. Customer-centric, trend-driven approach - Genuine passion for understanding merchant dynamics, physical and digital retail trends, and shifting consumer behaviors. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply. CareAbout: how we support your impact About We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops. 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries. ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply. 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours. 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness. We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time. Initial salary: Starting from €120,000.00 gross per annum This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value. Equal opportunity employer At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 55.000,00 €/yr - 85.000,00 €/anno Missoni is looking for a commercially driven and people-oriented Head of Retail to lead the performance, operations and profitability of its directly operated retail network , while also driving the strategic planning of its future expansion. The role is primarily focused on the management of the existing stores (store P&L, teams, assortment, visual merchandising, client experience and clienteling) and also includes responsibility for the development of the network , from the choice of the most suitable business model for each new opportunity ( DOS vs. Franchise ) to real estate and lease negotiations. Reporting directly to the head of the Commercial & Marketing Department , the Head of Retail will be the reference point for every retail-related decision, working in close partnership with Merchandise & Business Planning, Buying & Go-to-Market, Collection & Style Merchandising, Trade Marketing & Customer Experience, CRM & Clienteling, Wholesale and Finance . Key Responsibilities Store P&L, Budget & Cost Control Define and manage, with Finance , the P&L of each store, leading the annual retail budget and forecasts. Ensure every cost item is aligned with the annual budget and drive initiatives to optimize the retail cost base. Track key retail KPIs (like-for-like growth, traffic, conversion, average ticket, UPT, sales per sqm, sell-through) and turn insights into action plans. Assess the existing network to identify relocations, refurbishments, lease renegotiations or closures. Store Operations & People Leadership Lead the day-to-day management of the stores, ensuring operational excellence and consistent brand standards. Manage, coach and develop Store Managers and, through them, the entire store staff, fostering a high-performance, client-centric culture. Define staffing models and oversee recruitment, training, performance reviews and incentive schemes with HR . Assortment & Visual Merchandising Optimize the assortment of each store with the central omnichannel Buying team, and work with Merchandise & Business Planning on stock, replenishment and full-price sell-through. Hold direct accountability for in-store visual merchandising execution, defining with Collection Merchandising and Style the optimal setup for each store cluster. Client Experience, CRM & Clienteling Lead and be accountable for the in-store client experience, partnering with Trade Marketing & Customer Experience on its implementation with Store Managers and Sales Associates. Grow the contactable client database through targeted data capture incentives and staff engagement. Optimize the KPIs of the full clienteling funnel, from client outreach to in-store appointment and final transaction. Retail Expansion & Real Estate Define and execute the retail expansion plan, assessing with the Wholesale team whether each opportunity is best developed as a DOS or through a Franchise partnership. Drive location scouting and hold full accountability for lease negotiations with landlords. Build business cases for new openings, relocations and refurbishments (CAPEX, ROI, payback) and oversee new store projects through to opening. Candidate Profile 8–10 years of experience in Retail Management, Development or Operations within luxury companies, including managerial roles with responsibility for a store network and its P&L. Proven experience in leading Store Managers and multi-store teams. Strong financial acumen in store P&L, budgeting, business cases and cost control. Sensitivity for product, merchandise planning, visual merchandising and client experience, with a data-driven approach to clienteling KPIs. Solid track record in retail expansion and lease negotiations with top-tier landlords. Inspiring leadership, outstanding negotiation skills and strong cross-functional stakeholder management. Willingness to travel frequently. Fluency in Italian and English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus. Magneticam ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Magneticam. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 65.000,00 €/yr - 85.000,00 €/anno Magneticam diffonde per conto di Lovati&Associati la ricerca di un/a Sales Manager GDO per una multinazionale leader nel settore dei beni di consumo durevoli. La figura si inserirà in una fase di evoluzione organizzativa e crescita del business grazie allo sviluppo e lancio di prodotti innovativi che apriranno nuovi target di clientela. In particolare, avrà la responsabilità dello sviluppo commerciale del mercato italiano nel canale GDO/GDS e OnLine. La risorsa riporterà direttamente al General Manager ed è previsto un piano di crescita con responsabilità crescenti. Responsabilità & attività: Definire e implementare le strategie commerciali per il mercato italiano, con particolare focus sul canale GDO, individuando nuove opportunità di sviluppo e leve di crescita del fatturato; Sviluppare e consolidare le relazioni con clienti strategici, buyer, centrali d’acquisto, distributori e partner commerciali; Monitorare le performance di vendita rispetto agli obiettivi di fatturato e volume, individuando eventuali scostamenti e definendo le necessarie azioni correttive; Analizzare i trend di mercato, le esigenze dei clienti e le attività dei competitor, contribuendo all’individuazione di nuove opportunità commerciali; Gestire forecast di vendita, pipeline commerciale, pricing, promozioni e condizioni contrattuali, nel rispetto delle linee guida aziendali; Collaborare con le funzioni Marketing, Customer Service, Supply Chain e Finance per garantire un’efficace gestione degli ordini, dei pagamenti e la soddisfazione del cliente; Supportare il lancio di nuovi prodotti e le iniziative di marketing e sviluppo commerciale sul territorio; Predisporre report periodici sulle performance di vendita e condividere analisi e aggiornamenti con il General Manager; Contribuire all’evoluzione del modello commerciale aziendale, con possibilità di progressivo ampliamento delle responsabilità. Requisiti: Laurea triennale o magistrale in Economia o discipline affini; Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in ruoli commerciali analoghi presso aziende operanti nel settore dei beni di consumo durevoli, dei piccoli elettrodomestici o settori affini; Consolidata conoscenza del canale GDO e delle dinamiche di gestione delle centrali d’acquisto; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese Disponibilità a effettuare trasferte sul territorio nazionale e, in prospettiva, sui mercati europei. Completano il profilo: ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, orientamento al cliente e al risultato, autonomia organizzativa, flessibilità e attitudine a operare in un contesto dinamico e in evoluzione con prospettive di crescita. Sede di lavoro: Provincia di Milano, con trasferte sul territorio nazionale e, in prospettiva, sui mercati europei. Si offre: Per la posizione in oggetto la retribuzione annua lorda sarà compresa tra €65.000 – €85.000 per un contratto full time. Segnala offerta di lavoro Summary Bottega Veneta – inspiring individuality with innovative craftmanship since 1966. Creativity lies at the heart of all that we do. Born in Vicenza the house is rooted in Italian culture yet maintains a truly global outlook. An inclusive brand with exclusive products Bottega Veneta is as much of a feeling as it is an aesthetic. Job Description We are currently looking for a Corporate & Retail Solutions Project Manager to be part of our dynamic team, in Milan. How you will contribute: Define and own the strategy, roadmap and target architecture for corporate and retail solutions, aligned with business priorities and the overall TECH strategy; Lead the Retail Solutions Design & Delivery portfolio, setting priorities, developing capabilities and ensuring effective resource allocation; Oversee the end-to-end delivery of retail technology initiatives, from requirements and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment and continuous improvement; Provide functional and technical leadership for SAP FMS and its integration with the wider retail ecosystem, including merchandising, inventory, order management, allocation, POS, omnichannel and related platforms; Establish delivery governance, quality standards and architecture principles to ensure scalable, secure and supportable solutions across regions and brands; Manage the project portfolio, monitoring scope, budget, timing, resources, risks, dependencies and benefits, and implementing corrective actions when required; Partner with Retail, Finance, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Omnichannel and other business functions to translate strategic needs into pragmatic technology solutions; Manage key technology partners and system integrators, ensuring performance, accountability, knowledge transfer and value for money; Provide clear portfolio and delivery updates to senior management and steering committees, highlighting decisions, risks, issues and recommended actions; Ensure effective transition to operations and robust post-go-live support for all implemented solutions. Who you are: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related discipline; At least 4-5 years of experience in technology solution design and delivery, including significant leadership responsibility, preferably within fashion, luxury or retail organisations; Preferred functional and delivery experience with SAP FMS; knowledge of SAP Retail and integration with merchandising, supply chain, inventory, order management and finance processes is highly valued; Previous experience across retail technology projects, such as POS, omnichannel, clienteling, store operations, payments, RFID, inventory, order management and retail analytics; Proven ability to coordinate global, cross-functional programmes and complex system-integration landscapes from concept through stabilisation; Demonstrated people leadership, including team development, coaching, prioritisation and management of internal and external resources; Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, international teams and technology partners; Excellent analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and decision-making skills, with a strong delivery and customer-oriented mindset; Ability to combine strategic vision with hands-on leadership and to translate business objectives into coherent solution roadmaps; Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required. What we offer: CCNL Applied: National Collective Labour Agreement per gli Addetti alle Industrie Manifatturiere delle Pelli e Succedanei e Ombrelli e Ombrelloni Indicative Starting Salary: 40.000€ Variable pay: eligibility to a variable annual bonus linked to the achievement of individual and company objectives, in line with current company policies. Benefit: in addition to those provided by the applicable National Collective Labour Agreement and by law, further benefits and initiatives are provided in accordance with current company policies Why work with us? This is a fabulous opportunity to join the Kering adventure and to actively contribute to the development of the business by becoming part of a global Luxury Group that offers endless possibilities to learn and grow. Talent development is a managerial principle at Kering, and we are committed to fostering internal mobility. Our common vision promotes leadership skills and helps every employee to reach their full potential in a stimulating and fulfilling workplace environment. Kering is committed to building a diverse workforce. We believe diversity in all its forms – gender, age, nationality, culture, religious beliefs and sexual orientation – enriches the workplace. It opens opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to adapt to a changing world. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their background. Contribuirà inoltre alla crescita del gruppo attraverso il coordinamento delle nuove aperture e l’evoluzione dei format. Principali responsabilità: Gestione operativa dei locali. Definire attività, tempi e risorse per l’attuazione della strategia aziendale. Presidiare i processi operativi, produttivi e logistici, individuare le inefficienze e attuare interventi per migliorare i flussi di lavoro e ridurre i costi. Performance economica e controllo di gestione. Monitorare ricavi, scontrino medio, coperti, food cost, labour cost ed EBITDA per locale. Collaborare con CEO e CFO alla definizione del budget annuale e del forecast mensile. Analizzare i KPI settimanali e mensili, monitorare gli scostamenti e guidare i piani di miglioramento dei locali sotto obiettivo. Coordinamento e sviluppo dei team. Selezionare, guidare e valutare Area Manager e Direttori di locale, definendo percorsi di carriera e piani di successione. Coordinare i responsabili di cucina e sala tramite gli Area Manager e interfacciarsi con Supply Chain, Acquisti e Facility per gli aspetti operativi. Organizzazione del personale. Collaborare con HR su organici, turni, allocazione del personale, politiche retributive e retention, monitorando l’incidenza del costo del lavoro. Qualità, procedure e sicurezza. Presidiare gli standard di qualità e servizio, aggiornare le procedure operative e monitorare il piano di investimenti delle singole sedi. Verificare il rispetto delle normative in materia di HACCP, salute e sicurezza sul lavoro insieme ai referenti competenti. Nuove aperture e sviluppo dell’offerta. Pianificare e coordinare aperture, ristrutturazioni e chiusure, curando l’organizzazione e la formazione dei team e l’avvio operativo. Supportare CEO e CFO nelle valutazioni di fattibilità e nei business plan per nuove location. Contribuire all’evoluzione di menu, format e servizi, inclusi delivery, eventi e catering. Reporting e strumenti digitali. Analizzare con il CEO i report settimanali e mensili di produzione e vendita, riferire su andamento operativo, rischi e opportunità e migliorare gli strumenti a supporto dei locali, tra cui gestionali, POS, software di pianificazione dei turni e dashboard. Indicatori di performance: Fatturato ed EBITDA per locale rispetto al budget. Incidenza di food cost e labour cost sul fatturato. Soddisfazione del cliente ed esiti degli audit di qualità e HACCP. Turnover e tasso di assenteismo del personale. Rispetto di tempi e budget delle nuove aperture. Requisiti: 8–10 anni di esperienza nella ristorazione , di cui almeno 3 in ruoli di coordinamento multi-sede . Laurea in Economia, Gestione aziendale o discipline affini e formazione in ambito ristorazione o hospitality. Solida conoscenza del conto economico di locale (P&L), del budgeting e del controllo di gestione. Conoscenza delle normative HACCP e di sicurezza sul lavoro e del CCNL Pubblici Esercizi/Turismo. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo capacità di leadership e gestione dei team, orientamento ai risultati, capacità analitiche, gestione delle urgenze, capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione e attenzione al cliente e al brand. Sede e condizioni: Sede di lavoro – Milano, con trasferte frequenti presso i locali del gruppo. Inquadramento indicativo – Quadro. RAL – €75.000–€85.000, da definire in base all’esperienza. Retribuzione variabile – MBO pari al 15% della RAL. Segnala offerta di lavoro KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER – OFF-TRADE CHANNEL Are you thirsty for challenge, innovation and excellence, and ready to take your commercial career to the next level? Do you enjoy working in a dynamic, informal and collaborative environment—and yes, are you passionate about beer? This could be the perfect opportunity for you. Keep reading - we may be looking for exactly your profile! What You’ll Do Drive the growth and development of your assigned Off-Trade customers, ensuring strong performance across both sell-in and sell-out. Manage the key commercial levers—including assortment, shelf presence, visibility and promotional activities—to unlock sustainable growth. Develop and execute plans for new product launches, with a strong focus on listings, distribution and promotional strategy. Demonstrates deep knowledge of all P&L drivers and commercial levers, using financial analysis to build value-based negotiations and optimize framework agreements. Deliver accurate monthly customer forecasts in line with Demand Planning timelines and requirements. Build and present Customer Plans for top customers, providing regular updates during Quarterly Business Reviews with Senior Management. Analyse sell-in, sell-out, promotional and forecasting data, translating insights into clear and actionable plans. Oversee point-of-sale execution, working closely with the field sales force and local stakeholders to ensure agreed activities and investments are implemented effectively. Define and implement the full 4P marketing mix strategy for your customers. Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Trade Marketing, Marketing, Logistics and other teams to deliver an integrated customer approach. What We’re Looking For You are a commercially minded professional with strong sales and negotiation skills and a solid understanding of the Off-Trade market. You combine attention to detail with the ability to see the bigger picture, take ownership of decisions and stay focused on agreed priorities and business targets. You are analytical, organised and comfortable working with economic and commercial data. You enjoy collaborating with others and can build effective relationships with customers, field teams and cross-functional stakeholders. You have a proactive and curious mindset, continuously gathering insights to strengthen customer negotiations and decision-making. Master’s degree in Economics or a related field. Strong to excellent command of MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken (C1). What You Can Expect You will join a motivated, results-oriented team and manage key customers in the Off-Trade channel, with opportunities to learn, both formally and on the job, with the support of your manager and colleagues. We offer an informal working culture with passionate colleagues and we are proud to work for a company with an ambitious sustainability strategy—you will join our “Brewing Tomorrow” journey. We work as one team, locally and globally, we align to ensure transparency, take ownership of our results, act with speed and focus on the priorities that matter most. Employment package Employment type: Full-time, permanent contract Applicable National Collective Labour Agreement: Food Industry Gross annual salary: € 50.000 – 55.000 Variable compensation Benefits: company car, mobile phone, laptop Interested? Apply through the application form and send us your CV as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you! Carlsberg Group: Brewing for a better today and tomorrow For us success has always been in the diverse mix of our people, our beers and our brands. At Carlsberg, we want to recruit and develop people with a global mindset, cultural understanding, and international experience to ensure that our organization stays agile, inclusive and prepared for future growth. Only by acknowledging and harvesting from different perspectives and experiences, will we gain competitive advantage and leverage the effect of diversity for business growth. Carlsberg aims to create equal access to opportunity regardless of social identity, and we encourage everyone to apply regardless of gender, nationality, race, religion or any other characteristics protected by law. Ensure adherence to internal frameworks, policies, controls and quality standards. Demonstrative experience of managing or supporting customer segmentation, lifecycle marketing, and promotional campaign end-to-end. A proven ability to interpret performance metrics and turn data into actionable next steps. Strong analytical, organizational and collaborative skills Knowledge and experience with CRM tools and automation platforms Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English Why choose us: A dynamic environment within the world’s largest online gaming group. Nello specifico si occuperà di: gestire e presidiare l’infrastruttura IT aziendale, comprendente reti, server, ambienti cloud, postazioni di lavoro, sistemi di comunicazione e relativi servizi, garantendone affidabilità e continuità operativa; supervisionare e supportare le applicazioni aziendali, incluso l’ERP, assicurandone il corretto funzionamento, l’integrazione e l’evoluzione in relazione alle esigenze del business; presidiare la cybersecurity e la protezione di dati, sistemi e reti, gestendo accessi, backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, rischi tecnologici e incidenti informatici; governare l’introduzione e l’utilizzo di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale in azienda, valutandone opportunità applicative e assicurandone l’aderenza alle normative di riferimento; collaborare con la Direzione e con le diverse funzioni aziendali nell’analisi delle esigenze, nella definizione dei requisiti e nell’individuazione di soluzioni tecnologiche a supporto dei processi; coordinare fornitori, consulenti e partner tecnologici, monitorando livelli di servizio, qualità delle prestazioni e rispetto degli accordi; coordinare le attività di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria dell’infrastruttura, l’assistenza agli utenti e la predisposizione di procedure e documentazione a supporto dell’utilizzo dei sistemi IT; valutare nuove tecnologie, architetture e soluzioni applicative, promuovendo iniziative di razionalizzazione, automazione, integrazione dei sistemi e digitalizzazione dei processi; pianificare e coordinare i progetti IT, dalla raccolta dei requisiti e selezione delle soluzioni fino all’implementazione e alla messa a regime, monitorandone tempi, risultati e livelli di servizio; predisporre e gestire il budget IT, monitorando costi e investimenti e valutando i benefici generati dalle iniziative tecnologiche per il business. Segnala offerta di lavoro Langosteria ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Langosteria. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 60.000,00 €/yr - 70.000,00 €/anno La figura di Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager avrà il compito di definire e implementare la strategia Digital & Social Media del Gruppo e dei vari brand, coordinando la gestione dei canali digitali, la pianificazione editoriale, le campagne di comunicazione e le attività di CRM, con un perimetro di responsabilità esteso a tutti i brand e ai relativi touchpoint nei diversi mercati in cui il Gruppo opera. Riporterà direttamente al Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) e coordinerà il team di riferimento, assicurando coerenza e uniformità nella gestione delle strategie digitali e social. Collaborerà trasversalmente con Brand & Creative Design, PR & Communications, Operations, Event Team e referenti delle singole location, oltre che con la funzione CRM Analytics & Data Management, per valorizzare i dati e gli insight disponibili e tradurli in iniziative di marketing efficaci. Sarà responsabile della traduzione degli obiettivi di marketing in piani operativi e iniziative misurabili, in linea con il posizionamento dei brand e le strategie del Gruppo, con l'obiettivo di rafforzarne la visibilità, incrementare l'engagement, generare traffico qualificato, favorire le prenotazioni e sviluppare la fidelizzazione dei clienti. Strategia Digital & Social Media Definire e sviluppare piani annuali e trimestrali di Digital Marketing e Social Media, individuando priorità e obiettivi per ciascun brand, mercato e nuova apertura, in coerenza con il posizionamento e le linee guida del CMO. Gestire il piano editoriale, la pubblicazione dei contenuti e il presidio quotidiano dei canali social dei diversi brand. Coordinare le attività di Community Management, assicurando una gestione efficace delle interazioni e delle richieste degli utenti. Pianificare e coordinare la produzione di contenuti digitali e shooting fotografici, collaborando con Brand & Creative Design, PR & Communications, agenzie, fotografi e team delle singole location. Definire brief creativi, formati, materiali, tempistiche e obiettivi delle attività di produzione. Pianificare e ottimizzare campagne paid e iniziative digitali, monitorandone investimenti, target, traffico e risultati. Presidiare i touchpoint digitali dei diversi brand, inclusi siti web e pagine delle singole location, coordinando gli aggiornamenti e gli interventi necessari con i team interni e i fornitori. Analisi, Reporting e Monitoraggio delle Performance Monitorare le performance dei canali digitali, delle campagne social e delle attività CRM attraverso KPI e strumenti di analytics. Analizzare i risultati in termini di copertura, engagement, traffico, conversioni, prenotazioni e rendimento degli investimenti pubblicitari. Predisporre report periodici sull'andamento delle attività, evidenziando performance, costi, risultati e scostamenti rispetto agli obiettivi. Elaborare analisi e raccomandazioni operative, individuando criticità, opportunità di miglioramento e azioni correttive. Condividere aggiornamenti e risultati con il CMO e le funzioni aziendali coinvolte. CRM Strategy & Customer Activation Definire e implementare la strategia CRM del Gruppo, sviluppando attività di segmentazione, email marketing, campagne di comunicazione diretta e marketing automation. Progettare e gestire customer journey e iniziative di fidelizzazione, retention e riattivazione dei clienti. Pianificare campagne CRM mirate, individuando target, obiettivi, contenuti e modalità di attivazione, nel rispetto delle normative in materia di privacy e trattamento dei dati. Collaborare con la funzione CRM Analytics & Data Management per valorizzare dati, segmenti e insight disponibili, traducendoli in iniziative di marketing e attività di customer activation. Monitorare i risultati delle campagne CRM, individuando opportunità di miglioramento e ottimizzazione delle attività. Gestione Budget, Agenzie e Fornitori Gestire i budget assegnati alle attività Digital, Social Media e CRM, monitorando investimenti, costi e risultati. Coordinare agenzie, partner e fornitori esterni, definendo brief, priorità, obiettivi, scadenze e criteri di valutazione delle attività. Assicurare il rispetto delle tempistiche, dei budget approvati e degli standard qualitativi definiti dal Gruppo. Monitorare l'efficacia delle collaborazioni e individuare opportunità di efficientamento e miglioramento delle attività. REQUISITI Esperienza in ruoli di Digital Marketing e Social Media Management, preferibilmente all'interno di organizzazioni multi-brand e multi-location. Costituirà titolo preferenziale la provenienza dai settori Hospitality, Food & Beverage, Ristorazione, Luxury o Lifestyle. Esperienza nella definizione di strategie digitali, piani editoriali e budget, con responsabilità sul coordinamento e sull'implementazione delle attività. Esperienza nella gestione di agenzie, fornitori e partner esterni e nel coordinamento di progetti trasversali. Familiarità con social media management, paid media, content planning, web analytics, email marketing, CRM e piattaforme di marketing automation. Capacità di interpretare dati e indicatori di performance, elaborare report e tradurre gli insight in azioni concrete di ottimizzazione. OPPORTUNITÀ Entrare a far parte del Gruppo significa avere l'opportunità di inserirsi in un contesto dinamico e internazionale, caratterizzato da brand distintivi e progetti in continua evoluzione. Il percorso offrirà la possibilità di acquisire competenze trasversali nell'ambito delle Public Relations e della Comunicazione, lavorando a stretto contatto con il team e contribuendo ad attività e progetti che coinvolgono diversi brand e mercati internazionali. Un'esperienza formativa pensata per favorire la crescita professionale, sviluppare una visione ampia del settore luxury hospitality e approfondire le dinamiche della comunicazione in un Gruppo in costante espansione. NEXT STEP Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente. Se c’è un match con questa posizione, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca. L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting. In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro We are Reckitt Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege. Marketing Marketing is at the heart of Reckitt. We pride ourselves on our unique way of driving growth for some of the world's most loved and trusted health, hygiene and nutrition brands. Our purpose and fight are what motivates us to design and deliver distinctive communications throughout our consumer funnel, so that we deliver category growth as well as a positive impact on society. With extensive media and digital teams embedded throughout the organisation, we measure both our business and our societal impact. Our global teams lead on our overarching brand strategy, brand guardianship and innovation pipeline in close partnership with R&D. Leaving our local marketing teams to deliver on our regional goals in partnership with our Sales teams. With the scale of our 2500 marketing community - alongside our leading-edge Marketing Academy - your opportunities to grow and upskill will be extensive. About The Role You will be responsible for the development of the assigned category performance activations ensuring full optimization towards business goals. Thanks to your analysis and performance learnings’ evaluation, you will present strategic insights to maximise ROI across targeting, placements and retail media channel mix. Your responsibilities Working closely with the Consumer Engagement Lead and Digital & Content Manager for your category you will be central to the execution and continuous improvement of our brands performance activities. You will : Own the retail media and performance marketing agenda, ensuring investments deliver against category growth objectives. Lead the development and execution of performance marketing plans across Amazon and other retail media platform Define performance KPIs, measurement frameworks, and forecasting approaches to drive data-led decision making. Optimise campaign performance and ROI through continuous testing, learning, and performance analysis. Partner closely with Brand, Sales, Consumer Engagement, and agency teams to deliver integrated growth plans. Translate complex data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations for business stakeholders. Lead performance reviews, budget tracking, and forecasting processes to maximise commercial outcomes. Act as the key point of contact for major retail media events, including Prime Day and Black Friday. Segnala offerta di lavoro Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da SIAD S.p.A. Laura Covato Laura Covato SIAD è uno dei principali gruppi chimici italiani che opera nella produzione e vendita dell’intera gamma di gas industriali, alimentari, speciali, medicinali e gas refrigeranti, oltre che dei relativi servizi. SIAD fornisce assistenza di alta qualità al comparto dell’industria alimentare, automobilistica, metallurgica, chimica, medica, del vetro e della gomma. Siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire all’interno del Team Commerciale con specifica responsabilità di sviluppo della zona assegnata (Genova e provincia). Nello specifico dovrà: Acquisire nuovi clienti nel territorio di competenza; Mantenere contatti costanti con la clientela di competenza, fornendo un supporto tecnico e commerciale per conseguire la massima fidelizzazione ed incrementare il valore della fornitura di gas e servizi; Realizzare i programmi di rivalutazione prezzi secondo gli obiettivi assegnati; Assicurare il raggiungimento dei target di fatturato, prezzo, costi; Tenere sotto controllo costante le necessità del mercato e i relativi trend. Si richiede: Conoscenza del mercato di riferimento (realtà industriali dei settori farmaceutico e alimentare, ma anche automobilistico, metallurgico, chimico, del vetro e della gomma-plastica) e delle sue dinamiche; Dinamismo e forte orientamento al raggiungimento degli obiettivi; Ottime capacità di relazione, comunicazione e orientamento al cliente; Capacità di pianificazione del lavoro e di gestione delle priorità; Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office e in particolare Excel, nonché dimestichezza con piattaforme CRM; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese; Disponibilità a frequenti trasferte/spostamenti nell’area di competenza. Background formativo: Diploma o Laurea tecnica, preferibilmente in ambito chimico o scientifico. Esperienze professionali: Esperienza di almeno 5 anni maturata nella vendita B2B di prodotti tecnici rivolti al mondo industriale. Cosa offriamo: La possibilità di entrare in un contesto italiano di respiro internazionale, una realtà solida che crede fortemente nella formazione continua. Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato, con livello di partenza C2 del CCNL Chimico Industria, RAL a partire da 35.5K. La retribuzione annua lorda sarà commisurata all’effettiva esperienza maturata, alla formazione specifica e alle competenze tecniche e trasversali che saranno valutate in fase di colloquio. Welfare aziendale come disciplinato da accordo aziendale. Auto aziendale a uso promiscuo, carta carburante e telepass. Flessibilità oraria. Il presente annuncio si rivolge ai/alle candidati/e di ambo i sessi (Art. 27, comma 5, D.Lgs. 198/06). I/Le candidati/e potranno inviare la propria risposta rilasciando specifica autorizzazione ai sensi del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 (“GDPR”) relativo al trattamento dei dati personali. Base pay range €36,800.00/yr - €46,000.00/yr Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Job Ref ID: JR0088284 Ready to redefine how people access daily essentials? As a Senior Account Manager for Q-Commerce , you’ll own and grow one of Glovo’s most exciting and dynamic spaces — partnering with top brands and driving rapid expansion across high-demand categories like pharmacies, beauty, pet care, and beyond. You’ll be the driving force behind partner growth, commercial performance, and long-term success. This is your opportunity to build something big, fast: high autonomy, high impact, and a clear voice at the table as we shape the future of on-demand retail. If you're commercially sharp, data-driven, and love scaling partnerships from the ground up — this role’s got your name on it. The Journey Establish excellent relationships with Glovo’s partners through consistent and proactive communication, identifying their needs and building engagement (partner meetings and business reviews). Evaluate, follow up, and build reports on your portfolio and KPIs periodically, taking targeted actions to hit your goals and company OKRs. Design and execute joint business plans to grow partner accounts through promotional negotiations, marketing activations, and catalog performance (top-selling items, AOV, conversion rate, cross-selling, and upselling). Ensure Glovo provides the best offering by securing high-value partnerships. Optimize Glovo’s visibility through collaborative marketing actions with partners. Grow revenue through commercial renegotiations and asset monetization. Analyze, build action plans for, and re-engage churned and inactive partners. Enhance operational efficiency across partner accounts to ensure consistent, high-quality customer delivery. Actively collaborate and share best practices with teammates in a supportive environment focused on continuous development and shared impact. Qualifications WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE: 3–5 years of experience in sales, account management, or business development. Experience in e-commerce, Q-Commerce, FMCG, or fast-paced tech environments. Proven track record of closing deals and growing partner performance. Proactive, data-driven mindset with a strong bias for action. Strong commercial acumen — ability to translate GMV into media value, pitch bundled solutions, and navigate objections. Exceptional communication skills across all levels, from cross-functional internal stakeholders to external C-suite partners. Full professional proficiency in Italian and English. Moller - Maersk is a global logistics leader. With over 100,000 professionals in 130 countries, we are dedicated to simplifying and connecting global trade to help our customers grow competitively in current and new markets. Within our specialized Maersk Project Logistics (MPL) division, we offer tailored solutions to manage the complex project shipments of heavy lift, oversized (OOG) and other specialized cargo across multiple transport modes and industries. At Maersk, collaboration and a customer-centric mindset are key success factors. As a network-driven business, the ability to think and act beyond your own function and geography is essential. A customer-centric mindset means consistently considering customer value in every action—regardless of role or position. We believe in recognizing individual performance within highly professional teams, supported by our strong company values. We Offer: This is an exciting opportunity to join our MPL Operations team as a Operations Manager to execute best-in-class project logistics solutions and deliver exceptional service to our customers. You will be joining an international, fast-paced, growth-oriented environment and get exposure to complex, global logistics operations with multiple stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Accountable for the end-to-end planning, coordination and execution of complex project cargo operations, ensuring compliance with project timelines, Budget and customer requirements. Scope includes containerized, heavy lift, oversized (OOG), industrial equipment and other specialized cargo shipments, across the Renewable energy, Industry and Defense sectors. The role primarily focuses on the Italian market with some punctual coverage of Central Europe and Adriatic countries. Deliver safe, efficient and high-quality project logistics solutions in line with customer requirements while ensuring compliance with internal processes (includes on-site supervision where required) Prepare and maintain accurate shipment documentation, proactively escalating operational issues and providing mitigating solutions Proactively report milestone and status update to customers, ensuring on-time and cost-efficient execution Daily close collaboration with customers, vendors, partners and internal stakeholders Responsible for compliant vendor creation as per global process. Source and procure according to Global Authority Matrix and framework set by the Procurement department. Evaluate vendor and subcontractor proposals to ensure best value and quality. Monitor and update operational systems and tools (CargoWise), with project information, from file creation to invoicing, driving operational KPIs performance against targets. Adherence to MPL Standard Billing Cycle and Job Costing Policy to ensure timely and accurate invoicing Identify opportunities to improve project profitability and contribute to process standardisation and continuous improvement initiatives. We are looking for 5+ years of experience and proven track record in project freight forwarding Deep understanding of global supply chains and strong expertise of the Italian project logistics market Good customers know how and vendors relationship with containerized and over-dimensioned cargo service providers Analytical and operational mindset together with financial acumen and project management capabilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, matrixial environment. Excellent stakeholder management and inter-personal skills in a multi-cultural environment Proactive, organised and team player with a solution-oriented approach and can-do attitude. Fluency in English and Italian (verbal and written) Willingness and ability to travel punctually as per project requirements Why Maersk? At Maersk, you'll be part of a company that is transforming global logistics while creating opportunities for people, customers, and society. Michael Page ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Michael Page. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 55.000,00 €/yr - 62.000,00 €/anno Lead cloud financial management and governance across AWS and Azure, driving cost optimization, budgeting, forecasting, chargeback/showback models and FinOps practices in a complex enterprise environment. Partner with Finance, IT, Architecture and international stakeholders to align cloud investments with business objectives, improve transparency and maximize cloud value. Dettagli sul cliente Our client is a leading international organization undergoing an ambitious cloud transformation journey. With a strong focus on innovation, operational excellence and digital enablement, the company is investing in cloud technologies to accelerate business growth, enhance efficiency and strengthen governance across its global operations. As part of this evolution, the organization is looking for a Cloud Governance & FinOps Manager to drive cloud financial management, optimize cloud investments and foster a culture of accountability, transparency and value realization across AWS and Azure environments. Descrizione Our organization is increasingly leveraging cloud solutions. We are therefore seeking a Cloud Governance & FinOps Manager to join our local Cloud Business Office (CBO) and lead cloud financial management while strengthening the broader governance, strategy and innovation agenda. The role will ensure efficient management of financial resources, optimize cloud usage and investment, and align cloud priorities, operating practices and performance indicators with the objectives and approaches of the Group Cloud Business Office. The candidate will bring 4-8+ years of experience across Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Management and Cloud Governance for AWS and Azure platforms, together with proven ability to work across finance, technology, architecture and product environments. Strong analytical and communication skills are required to interpret complex financial and operational data, translate group objectives into actionable plans, and interact frequently and effectively with Group stakeholders, including Cyber Security and other central functions. Embark on an exciting career opportunity and help shape the future of technology as cloud adoption continues to evolve across a complex international environment. How you'll live your ambition We're looking for a talented professional to join the Cloud Business Office and Architecture Team. If you're ready and willing to embark on an innovative adventure, read on to discover how you can help drive cloud adoption, governance and financial optimization across the organization. Demonstrate your passion Lead the FinOps effort to manage and optimize cloud spend across multiple platforms, mainly AWS and Azure, developing and implementing strategies that align cloud usage with business and Group financial objectives. Own cloud budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, showback and chargeback practices, business cases and financial performance reporting, improving transparency and accountability for cloud consumption. Act as the primary liaison with the central Group Cloud Business Office, maintaining frequent interaction and ensuring alignment with Group cloud strategy, governance frameworks, financial approaches, KPIs and common initiatives. Translate Group Cloud Business Office priorities, standards and practices into roadmaps and actionable initiatives, while representing local requirements, results and opportunities within Group forums. Collaborate with key stakeholders, including Finance, IT Leadership, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps and Product teams, to integrate financial management and governance throughout the cloud adoption lifecycle. Promote a strong FinOps and cloud governance culture across the organization, increasing awareness of cost optimization, value realization, ownership and responsible cloud consumption. Support cloud strategy and innovation by assessing new capabilities, technologies and provider offerings, identifying opportunities consistent with business needs and Group objectives. Promote transparency in cloud cost allocation and usage, ensuring accurate attribution to business units, products or teams and enabling informed investment decisions. Lead initiatives to automate cloud cost management and governance processes, including cost tracking, controls, dashboards, reporting and KPI monitoring. Get things right Monitor cloud usage, spending and value delivery to ensure efficiency, cost-effectiveness and alignment with approved budgets and forecasts. Analyze cloud cost data, consumption trends, invoices and operational indicators to provide actionable insights and strategic recommendations. Design and implement policies, guardrails, processes and tools to control cloud costs, manage risk and support performance, scalability and innovation. Establish and monitor financial, operational and governance KPIs, tracking performance against budget, local objectives and Group scorecards. Drive continuous improvement plans where financial, governance or Group-alignment targets are not met, coordinating accountable stakeholders and monitoring results. Facilitate benchmarking and reuse of Group practices, helping the organization benefit from common standards, shared experience and innovation. Prepare clear management reporting and decision support for senior leadership and Group stakeholders, highlighting performance, risks, opportunities and required actions. Safety First Your innovative thinking and passion will guide you to promote corporate culture and values among employees, leveraging positive relationships with company leaders to achieve business results. Profilo del Candidato What makes you unique Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field. 4-8+ years of experience in cloud financial operations, cloud cost management, cloud governance, cloud strategy or a similar role, with a focus on enterprise cloud infrastructure. Proven experience working across cross-functional and international teams, particularly within finance, technology, architecture, product or cloud environments. Experience working in a multinational or federated organization and interacting with central governance bodies, business offices or Group-level stakeholders. Strong understanding of cloud platforms, mainly AWS and Azure, governance capabilities and enterprise operating models. Expertise in cloud financial management tools such as CloudHealth, Cloudability and AWS Cost Explorer, and in dashboards, reporting and data-driven performance management. Solid analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex cost, usage and KPI data and provide strategic, financially grounded recommendations. Ability to connect cloud investment decisions with business value, financial accountability, strategic priorities and measurable outcomes. Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and operate effectively without direct authority. Ability and willingness to communicate and interact frequently with central governance functions and Group stakeholders. Fluent English is essential (B2 level); additional languages are a plus. Promote openness and transparency, and welcome feedback and other people's ideas. Open to diversity and cultural differences. offerta di lavoro Ottima opportunità di carriera. Confidenza con il settore della Pubblica Amministrazione , soprattutto Centrale, e significativa conoscenza delle sue dinamiche di acquisto, Apprezzata la confidenza con l’ambito ECM / BPM e piattaforme “orizzontali”.(Document Management, Workflow Management…) Cultura a livello universitario. Segnala offerta di lavoro [Please note this is a Direct Search led by Bacardi, Applications from agencies will not be accepted nor will fees be paid for unsolicited CVs.] National Account Manager C&C and WHS WHO ARE WE? Bacardi Is a Family, a Company And a Brand A family-owned company full of passionate employees and iconic brands, shaped by our rich history of spirited entrepreneurship. Bacardi Limited is built on the enduring legacy of a family. Ours is a vibrant, family owned spirits company, nurtured by seven generations of the Bacardí family. We are the largest, privately held spirits company. Bacardi was founded in 1862 in Santiago de Cuba, when Don Facundo Bacardí Massó revolutionized the spirits industry by creating the world’s first light-bodied rum. Since then, our Company has grown to encompass an impressive portfolio of more than 200 brands and labels. These include BACARDÍ® rum, the world’s best-selling and most-awarded rum, as well as the world’s most-awarded spirit; GREY GOOSE® vodka, the world’s leading super-premium vodka; DEWAR’S® Blended Scotch whisky, the world’s most awarded blended Scotch; BOMBAY SAPPHIRE® gin, the top valued and fastest growing premium gin in the world; MARTINI® vermouth and sparkling wines, the world’s leading vermouth and the world's favorite Italian sparkling wines; CAZADORES® 100% blue agave tequila, one of the most popular premium tequilas in Mexico and the United States; and other leading and emerging brands including WILLIAM LAWSON’S®, the fastest-growing global Scotch whisky brand; ERISTOFF® vodka, one of the fastest-growing vodka brands in the world; and ST. GERMAIN®, a super-premium elderflower liqueur. We are focused on building upon our successes by recruiting the best and brightest talent in order to have a well balanced employee population that reflects our diverse society, customers and consumers. Around the globe we employ nearly 6,000 people who are the guardians of a tradition of excellence dating back more than 152 years. Our products are sold in more than 150 markets worldwide by our own companies and third-party distributors, and we operate 27 production facilities – for bottling, distilling and manufacturing – in 16 countries. Bacardi Limited refers to the Bacardi group of companies, including Bacardi International Limited. The Company is headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda. OUR WAYS OF WORKING Our family legacy has positively influenced our ways of working and has shaped the values to which our employees aspire. We’re caring, like a family, and not only internally, but also in the wider communities in which we operate. This is demonstrated by our commitment to both act responsibly and promote the choice to drink responsibly. We trust one another, and through that trust are able to forge strong teams and networks that empower our matrix organization structure. We’re passionate, reflecting our Latin heritage, and this means that we commit more than just time to our work: we commit energy, heart and soul. We are dedicated to being a role model in our industry, and we approach everything we do with Integrity First. Together, our values help us create what we’re most proud of: our True Heart and Winning Spirit – both in our home markets and across the world. About The Role You will own the channel strategy and performance, with accountability for revenue, gross margin, profitability, return on investment, mix and value share. You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, working closely with customers and cross-functional teams to turn opportunities into measurable results. What You’ll Do Drive Commercial Performance Own and deliver channel KPIs, including NSV, gross margin, profitability, ROI and value share. Execute channel and marketing programs aligned with the Country Integrated Activity Plan. Use market, customer and shopper insights to shape channel and portfolio strategy. Champion commercial discipline and execution excellence across customers. Lead Customer Partnerships Manage national key customers across Cash & Carry and Wholesalers, including integrated distributors, buying alliances and B2B players. Understand customer strategies and use our value proposition to unlock mutual growth. Build the Picture of Success with the CPA team to activate our brands at the point of sale. Lead Joint Business Plans, annual negotiations and price increases, delivering clear win-win outcomes. Optimize price and pack architecture, promotional plans and pay-for-performance agreements to improve mix, value and ROI. Plan, Collaborate and Lead Provide accurate, timely demand forecasts to Supply Chain. Represent channel and customer priorities in the country IAP process. Partner with Marketing, CPA and Finance to maximize commercial impact. Lead, coach and develop three direct reports, fostering accountability, collaboration and continuous growth. What You Bring A strong record of delivering sustainable commercial results with customers. Proven experience managing national key accounts in FMCG, Wholesale or Cash & Carry environments. Excellent negotiation, influencing and relationship-building skills. First-hand field sales experience and a solid understanding of category management and sales effectiveness. Strong commercial judgment, analytical capability and advanced Excel skills. Professional proficiency in English. A high level of ownership, resilience, team spirit and focus on results. About You You are curious, driven and comfortable navigating a dynamic environment. You bring a hands-on mindset, a desire to win and the calm credibility to perform under pressure. You simplify complex challenges, enjoy collaborating across functions and customers, and share our passion for drinks, hospitality and entertainment. What We Offer Gross annual salary starting from €64,000. Bonus aligned with our Sales Variable Plan. Company car Permanent, full-time employment under the CCNL Alimentare. Reports to the On-Trade Sales Lead and manages three direct reports. If you are ready to make an impact, grow iconic brands and build winning partnerships, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and bring your unique perspective to Bacardi. LEADERSHIP AGILITY At Bacardi we care deeply about finding brilliant talent who can bring the following personal attributes to help elevate our 3Fs: Fearless, Family, Founder culture to the next level. Belonging: You have a strong capacity to create a culture of ‘Belonging’, where people feel appreciated for who they are, what they do, and who they can become Self-Awareness: You have high levels of self-awareness, are reflective and know yourself well, understanding both your own strengths and weaknesses and your impact on others People Agility: You bring a deep ability to understand and relate to people and navigate through tough situations to harness and multiply collective performance Results Agility: You demonstrate consistent delivery of results in first-time situations by inspiring teams, exhibiting a presence that builds confidence in yourself and others. Mental Agility: You can think critically to penetrate complex problems and expand the possibilities by making fresh connections. You think strategically whilst being execution focused and bring creativity to the challenges you’re presented with Change Agility: You have a deep natural curiosity, desire to experiment and ability to effectively deal with the heat of change. You have a growth and learning mindset: ready to test, stumble, learn and apply from experience Disclaimer: Bacardi seeks talent from all backgrounds to bring diversity of thought, agility and capability to our organization across the globe. We promote a working environment where all employees are treated and rewarded fairly. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination that adversely affects individuals or groups on the basis of national origin, race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, age, and any other legally protected aspect of a person’s identity. U.S. applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws. Perks of Working for us At Bacardi, we are committed to providing our Primos (employees) with a comprehensive Total Rewards package of compensation, benefits, incentives, allowances, well-being, and much more to meet the needs of themselves and their families. It goes beyond just Cash! The total rewards program is based on pay for performance, whereby the incentive programs are linked to company and individual performance. Compensation, Paid Time Off & Retirement: Competitive Pay Package Competitive Holiday/Paid Time Off, plus additional days offered ( i.e., volunteer day, allowing you to give back to the community) Retirement/Pension Plan Health & Wellbeing Medical, Critical Illness, and Life Insurance Employee Assistance Programs Best-in-class, family-friendly, and inclusive leave policies Additional Benefits The benefits /perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Bacardi, your work location, and are subject to change. Some benefits may be subject to an employee contribution. Some benefits may be fully or partially subsidized. Incentive plans are linked to the nature of your employment and can vary based on region, market, function or brand. At Bacardi, we want to get to know you and understand your own experience, capabilities and perspectives during the interview. We therefore ask that you do not use AI assistance during live or pre-recorded interviews.
